title: Dittany: Contribution-Guided Repair Framework for MAS Applications
title_zh: Dittany：面向多智能体应用的贡献引导式修复框架

paragraphs.en: Dittany通过贡献图引导多智能体应用的运行时修复，显著提升任务准确率并降低token消耗。 LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) applications can produce useful intermediate results while leaving task requirements unsatisfied. Repairing such executions requires identifying the work still needed and the completed results that can support it. We present \tool, a contribution-guided runtime repair framework for MAS applications. \tool derives expected contributions and acceptance conditions from task requirements and method specifications, and connects their dependencies in a contribution graph. Runtime checks locate unmet conditions and establish which results remain usable. These results guide action-level correction when available inputs suffice, or graph-level recovery when prerequisites or unfinished work need revision. Both repair scopes retain validated contributions and check repaired outputs before subsequent work uses them. We evaluate \tool on 30 applications across six MAS frameworks and 9,000 tasks. It detects runtime failures with 88.28\% precision and 79.18\% recall, and achieves 84.76\% task accuracy, improving over Native execution by 26.74 percentage points and the strongest of four recovery baselines by 21.28 points. Estimated deployment token consumption is 17.92\% above Native, but 24.19\% below Reflexion and 13.05\% below Iterative Rollback. Ablation results show that combining the two repair scopes achieves higher accuracy and lower token consumption than graph-level repair alone.
paragraphs.zh: Dittany通过贡献图引导多智能体应用的运行时修复，显著提升任务准确率并降低token消耗。基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）应用可以在任务需求尚未满足的情况下产生有用的中间结果。 修复此类执行需要识别仍需完成的工作，以及可以支持这些工作的已完成结果。 我们提出\tool，一个面向MAS应用的贡献引导运行时修复框架。\tool从任务需求和方法规范中推导预期贡献与接受条件，并将它们的依赖关系连接成贡献图。 运行时检查定位未满足的条件，并确定哪些结果仍然可用。 当可用输入足够时，这些结果引导动作级修正；当先决条件或未完成工作需要修订时，则引导图级恢复。 两种修复范围都保留经过验证的贡献，并在后续工作使用修复后的输出之前对其进行检查。 我们在六个MAS框架的30个应用和9,000个任务上评估\tool。 它以88.28%的精确率和79.18%的召回率检测运行时故障，达到84.76%的任务准确率，比原生执行提升26.74个百分点，比四个恢复基线中最强的一个提升21.28个百分点。 估计的部署token消耗比Native高17.92%，但比Reflexion低24.19%，比Iterative Rollback低13.05%。 消融实验结果表明，结合两种修复范围比仅使用图级修复实现更高的准确率和更低的token消耗。
